title: OPTARI: An open-source software framework for clinical translation of optoacoustic imaging
abstract: arXiv:2610.32468v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Combined optoacoustic (OptA) and ultrasound imaging is a promising modality across a wide range of pathologies. Its use in clinical research, however, is limited by a lack of analysis software accessible to users without programming expertise. Existing tools are either script-based engineering frameworks or proprietary vendor applications. We present OPTARI, an open-source graphical software application to facilitate large-scale clinical optoacoustic-ultrasound (OPUS) studies. OPTARI builds on the napari image viewer and the PATATO toolkit for OptA data processing. It supports native vendor and open HDF5 data formats, aligns with the IPASC standard, and is distributed as a standalone executable. Features include region-of-interest annotation, reconstruction, chromophore unmixing, deep-learning-based tissue segmentation, and temporal and spectral analysis modules. translated_title: OPTARI：一个用于光声成像临床转化的开源软件框架
translated_abstract: 光声与超声联合成像是一种在多种病理范围内具有广阔前景的成像方式。然而，由于缺乏可供没有编程专业知识的用户使用的分析软件，其在临床研究中的应用受到限制。现有工具要么是基于脚本的工程框架，要么是厂商专有的应用程序。我们提出了OPTARI，一个开源的图形化软件应用，旨在促进大规模临床光声-超声（OPUS）研究。OPTARI基于napari图像查看器和PATATO工具包构建，用于光声数据处理。它支持厂商原生和开放的HDF5数据格式，符合IPASC标准，并以独立可执行程序的形式分发。其功能包括感兴趣区域标注、图像重建、发色团解混、基于深度学习的组织分割以及时间和光谱分析模块。OPTARI提供了目前其他软件无法实现的临床研究分析功能组合。
tldr: OPTARI是一个基于napari和PATATO构建的开源图形化软件，使无编程背景的研究人员能够完成大规模临床光声-超声研究的全流程分析，涵盖图像重建、感兴趣区标注、发色团解混、深度学习组织分割以及时间与光谱分析。
en_tdlr: OPTARI is an open-source graphical software framework built on napari and PATATO that enables programming-free, end-to-end analysis for large-scale clinical optoacoustic-ultrasound studies, including reconstruction, region-of-interest annotation, chromophore unmixing, deep-learning-based segmentation, and temporal and spectral analysis.
